name: @dsh-plugins/memory-palace
description: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents — and any MCP client. Memory Capsules for inter-agent knowledge transport, self-reflective retrieval tuning, four-tier visibility ACL, PRF + entity-hop recall, as-of flashback, personalized PageRank, tombstone right-to-be-forgotten.

provider.description: deepseek falls back to offline-bm25 at runtime when the API is unreachable (circuit breaker)

minScore.description: Floor on RAW cosine similarity (pre-decay). Raise to ~0.3 for dense embedding providers

graphBoost.description: Weight of the zero-mean PageRank prior applied to items linked to graph entities (0 disables)

prf.description: Pseudo-relevance feedback (Rocchio): blend the top-hit centroid back into the query vector and re-score — zero-LLM query expansion

alpha.description: Weight of the original query vector

entityHop.description: Graph-guided second pass: items linked to the top hits entities that the vector gate missed

queryCache.description: Deterministic semantic cache for near-duplicate queries (anchor-bucketed, cosine-verified)

ivf.description: Deterministic IVF bucket index — pure accelerator; probe radius escalates until the candidate pool is satisfied, and all-keys equals the exact scan (recall never depends on the index)

radius.description: Starting Hamming probe radius (1 probes 5 of 16 buckets)

minItems.description: Engage IVF only above this many items in the space — below it the exact scan is already fast

fusionLearning.description: Online fusion learning: engagement feedback moves vector/keyword blend weights inside fixed safety rails (±20% of defaults), with decaying reward history and a full audit journal

quantization.description: Vector storage precision: int8 = 4× denser with measured cosine error (<0.005 for d≤1024); float32 = exact

writeDedupeThreshold.description: Raw-cosine floor for memory_remember's near-duplicate scan: a NON-contradictory existing hit at/above it returns the existing id instead of storing a clone, while a contradictory one falls through to the conflict path. Clamped to [0.5, 1] at use time; NaN falls back to 0.92

conflictScanThreshold.description: Raw-cosine floor for memory_remember's conflict scan — existing memories at/above it are checked for contradictions (differing values, affirmative vs negated). Clamped to [0, 1] at use time; NaN falls back to 0.75

eventRetentionDays.description: Episodic events older than this are pruned during compression

tombstoneRetentionDays.description: Tombstones older than this are hard-deleted during compression

pagerankEdgeDecayDays.description: Half-life (days) for edge-weight recency decay; 0 disables

personalizationWeight.description: Blend between global PageRank and query-personalized PPR (1 = pure PPR when query entities are known)

systemPromptPrefix.default: You have access to a long-term memory palace. When the user references past context, consult it via the memory_retrieve tool before answering.

warmRanks.description: Pre-warm personalized PageRank for the opening intent entities (local, free)

coreBudgetFraction.description: Fraction of the injection budget reserved for core SELF blocks (0 disables core injection)

oneOf.description: Legacy scalar form: home visibility tier for new memories.

kind.description: Home visibility tier for new memories; retrieval widens session→workspace→user→global and never crosses owner boundaries. memory_remember may override per item (visibility: global etc.).

anonymousPolicy.description: Policy for writes carrying no owner id at all: global = shared bucket (legacy default), quarantine = isolated __anonymous__ session bucket invisible to identified users, reject = fail-closed drop.

adminUserIds.description: When configured, live calls to global side-effect tools (memory_migrate's whole-store re-embed) require the caller's userId to be listed here; unconfigured = single-user trust model (any caller). Empty array or empty-string elements are rejected at install time.

scope.description: Home visibility tier for new memories; retrieval widens session→workspace→user→global and never crosses owner boundaries. memory_remember may override per item (visibility: global etc.). Anonymous callers see the global tier only; anonymous WRITES are governed by anonymousPolicy (object form).
